chapters.title: Start learning Generative AI
chapters.outcome: Explain a generative system, set up the small labs and choose a practical learning goal.

chapters.title: The math behind a prediction
chapters.outcome: Use vectors, probability, loss and a small gradient update without skipping the notation.

chapters.title: Tokens and language modeling
chapters.outcome: Follow text through token IDs, causal prediction and a language-model objective.

chapters.title: Represent meaning with embeddings
chapters.outcome: Compare lexical and learned representations, compute similarity and choose a retrieval representation.

chapters.title: Understand attention, one weighted sum at a time
chapters.outcome: Calculate queries, keys, values and a causal attention result you can inspect.

chapters.title: Multi-head attention and efficient inference
chapters.outcome: Separate model structure, attention approximation and hardware-efficient implementation.

chapters.title: Assemble a transformer
chapters.outcome: Connect attention, residual paths, normalization, positions and feed-forward blocks.

chapters.title: How language models are trained
chapters.outcome: Distinguish pretraining, instruction tuning and preference optimization, with sound data splits.

chapters.title: Generate the next token
chapters.outcome: Use temperature, top-k, nucleus sampling and stopping rules deliberately.

chapters.title: Serve a model and manage long context
chapters.outcome: Reason about prefill, decoding, memory, context extension and latency budgets.

chapters.title: Write instructions and validate outputs
chapters.outcome: Build a clear task contract, useful examples and a checked structured response.

chapters.title: Engineer the context
chapters.outcome: Select and budget instructions, evidence, state and memory while retaining provenance.

chapters.title: Build a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline
chapters.outcome: Follow ingestion, retrieval, context assembly and cited generation end to end.

chapters.title: Improve retrieval and choose a RAG design
chapters.outcome: Use hybrid retrieval, reranking, query transformations and multi-hop designs when evidence supports them.

chapters.title: Project: a grounded workshop assistant
chapters.outcome: Build a small inspectable retrieval-and-answer prototype with citations and an abstention path.

chapters.title: Measure quality before changing the system
chapters.outcome: Evaluate retrieval and answers separately, using held-out cases and meaningful baselines.

chapters.title: Evaluate with a calibrated LLM judge
chapters.outcome: Design pointwise, pairwise and listwise judgments, then check bias and human agreement.

chapters.title: Operate and improve a GenAI application
chapters.outcome: Trace failures, budget cost and latency, and release a versioned system through explicit checks.

chapters.title: Adapt a model with parameter-efficient tuning
chapters.outcome: Choose a tuning method and understand what a LoRA or quantized-base update changes.

chapters.title: Transfer behavior with knowledge distillation
chapters.outcome: Compare teacher-student objectives, data policies and the evidence needed to assess a smaller model.

chapters.title: Design a bounded agent loop
chapters.outcome: Define state, observations, tool contracts, progress checks and termination before adding autonomy.

chapters.title: Connect work with a reliable graph
chapters.outcome: Choose graph topologies, handle parallel results and define recovery at every boundary.

chapters.title: Project: an assistant workflow you can replay
chapters.outcome: Connect retrieval, verification and a checkpointed controller with explicit failure states.

chapters.title: Learn to reverse a noising process
chapters.outcome: Understand the forward process, learned denoising and what an inference sampler actually does.

chapters.title: Condition image and video generation
chapters.outcome: Compare latent models, U-Nets, DiTs, guidance and sampling or adaptation choices.

chapters.title: Connect images and language
chapters.outcome: Distinguish aligned embeddings, multimodal fusion and generative vision-language models.

chapters.title: Build and evaluate a multimodal system
chapters.outcome: Keep spatial and temporal evidence intact through multimodal retrieval, generation and evaluation.

chapters.title: Model sequences with a state-space model
chapters.outcome: Trace recurrent state, structured and selective SSMs, and their memory trade-offs.

chapters.title: Understand recursive computation
chapters.outcome: Separate repeated model depth, latent reasoning and recursive program-controlled model calls.

chapters.title: Predict a world and plan within it
chapters.outcome: Distinguish rendering, simulation, latent prediction and planning with an imperfect learned model.

chapters.title: Connect perception, prediction and action
chapters.outcome: Understand VLA policies, data, simulation and the requirements of closed-loop embodied evaluation.

chapters.title: Capstone: explain, test and improve your assistant
chapters.outcome: Produce a reproducible prototype, an evaluation report and a justified next experiment.
